evidence.reason: The assertion strips the first character of every encoded line instead of asserting that the character is '+'. A wrong one-character prefix, such as a space, still yields the original text after `line[1:]`, so the test can pass while the patch lacks an added-line prefix, including on the line after `\u0085`. The lone-CR assertion covers a different input. This is a test correctness defect, not a new requirement.
